    - Brightwater's travelling show. Painted wagons, acrobats, and a dancing goat called Duchess who hated everyone. My parents tumbled in it. I was born in a wagon somewhere between two towns.
    - Cassius, the show's fire-eater, taught me from eleven. He died the winter before the show reached Urbanograd. When the wagons left, I stayed. Nobody here told me to stop. The show never came back.
